notes: Historical currency amounts are in full USD (not millions). Revenue and operating income (EBIT proxy) come from the consolidated income statement; D&A and capex come from the consolidated statement of cash flows. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

Working capital (NWC) definition used here is: NWC = (Total current assets − Cash and equivalents) − Total current liabilities. This yields negative NWC for all three historical years, with the large 2023 swing driven by a higher cash balance. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/63908/000006390825000012/mcd-20241231.htm))

WACC (0.08) and terminal exit multiple (18.0x EV/EBITDA) are base-case modeling assumptions; they were not directly extracted from the filings in this pass and should be overridden if your pipeline uses a different methodology. (No primary-source WACC/exit-multiple quote was retrieved here.)

NOL utilization percent is left null because the filing discloses NOL carryforwards but does not provide an explicit utilization rate/plan for DCF utilization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))
current_price = 308.85 uses the latest available finance snapshot (latest trade was reported as Mar 20 close/time), while as_of_date is set to 2026-03-21.

catalysts: Sustained traffic and value momentum reflected in comparable sales (Q4 2025 strong comp performance). ([corporate.mcdonalds.com](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/content/dam/sites/corp/nfl/pdf/MCD%20Q4-25%20-%20Exhibit%2099.1%20-%20vF.pdf))

Execution against 2026 restaurant development targets and associated cash return profile as capex ramps and margins normalize. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))
Potential for operating margin outcomes to trend above/below the guided mid-to-high 40% band. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Franchises and owns/operates McDonald's restaurants across 100+ countries; ~95% of restaurants were franchised at year-end 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

2025 total revenues were $26,885,000,000 and operating income was $12,393,000,000 (operating margin 46.1%). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

Heavily franchised model is designed to generate stable and predictable revenue largely linked to franchisee sales and cash flow streams. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))
current_context: Full-year 2025: global comparable sales +3.1% and consolidated revenues +4% to $26.885 billion; consolidated operating income +6% to $12.393 billion. ([corporate.mcdonalds.com](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/content/dam/sites/corp/nfl/pdf/MCD%20Q4-25%20-%20Exhibit%2099.1%20-%20vF.pdf))

Q4 2025: global comparable sales +5.7% (global guest counts positive) with consolidated revenues up 10%. ([corporate.mcdonalds.com](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/content/dam/sites/corp/nfl/pdf/MCD%20Q4-25%20-%20Exhibit%2099.1%20-%20vF.pdf))

Outlook for 2026: operating margin expected in the mid-to-high 40% range; effective tax rate 21%–23%; 2026 capex $3.7–$3.9 billion. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is modest (mid-single digit to high-single digit growth in systemwide drivers implied by comparable sales and restaurant expansion) given 2026 unit expansion contribution of ~2.5% to systemwide sales growth. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

EBIT margins are anchored near recent levels with an assumed gradual normalization consistent with 2026 expectation for operating margin in the mid-to-high 40% range. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

Capital intensity is elevated through 2027 per company guidance for incremental capex, supporting new unit openings while later years taper toward a steadier reinvestment rate. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

Tax assumptions incorporate McDonald's reported effective tax rate and disclosed NOL carryforwards (with utilization left null due to lack of explicit utilization rate). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))
key_risks: If comparable sales/guest counts weaken, operating leverage could compress versus base-case EBIT margins. ([corporate.mcdonalds.com](https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/content/dam/sites/corp/nfl/pdf/MCD%20Q4-25%20-%20Exhibit%2099.1%20-%20vF.pdf))

International FX and inflation/commodity pressures may affect both revenues and costs, impacting margin and capex efficiency. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

Higher-than-modeled interest rates or financing costs could raise the effective discount rate and reduce equity value. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

valuation_summary: DCF base-case uses company-reported financial structure: revenues, operating income (EBIT proxy), depreciation/amortization, and capex are directly taken from the 2023–2025 consolidated statements. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))

Terminal assumptions (terminal growth and exit EV/EBITDA multiple) are set to economically sensible steady-state levels for a mature franchised/global QSR model, and can be overridden in the pipeline. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000063908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm))
Comps section is populated with relevant peers; NTM multiples were not pulled from a primary/free source in this pass (left null to avoid overstating precision).
